# @sharadox/account-web-library

> Passwordless accounts for web applications (one-time codes to contacts, TOTP two-factor, roles and bans per application, OpenID Connect for people and agents), built on standards without an auth framework. 0.1.0: building blocks and account storage in Postgres (Kysely).

- /identifier: checkIdentifier(name) → { valid: true, identifier, key (lowercase) } | { valid: false, reason: "length" | "characters" }; rules /^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:[-_.][A-Za-z0-9]+)*$/, 1–50 (IDENTIFIER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH); identifierKey(name) → lowercase (unique index; abc = aBc)
- /one-time-code: createOneTimeCode(length = 6) → digits (crypto.randomInt); hashOneTimeCode(code, { pepper (≥32 chars), purpose }) → base64url HMAC-SHA-256 of `${purpose}\n${code}`; matchesOneTimeCode(code, hash, options) → boolean, spaces ignored, constant-time
- /totp: createTotpSecret() → 20 random bytes; totpCode(secret, nowMs, { digits = 6, period = 30 }) (RFC 6238 SHA-1); verifyTotp(secret, code, nowMs, { lastUsedStep }) → { valid: true, step } | { valid: false }, window ±1 step, steps ≤ lastUsedStep refused; totpUri({ issuer, account, secret }) → otpauth://totp/Issuer:account?secret=BASE32&issuer=…&algorithm=SHA1&digits=6&period=30
- /base-32: encodeBase32(bytes) (RFC 4648, no padding); decodeBase32(text) (case, spaces, = ignored; throws on other characters)
- /effective-permissions: effectivePermissions({ application, resource?, now, defaultRole, roles: Role[] { id, application|null, permissions, exclusive }, grants: Grant[] { roleId, application|null, resource|null, startsAt, endsAt|null }, scope?, ownerPermissions? }) → Set; active exclusive (ban) roles override; else default ∪ active; keeps "<application>." and "account." permissions; ∩ scope ∩ ownerPermissions
- /ban-length: banLength([{ schedule: (seconds | "permanent")[], previousOffenses }]) → max penalty (permanent wins); schedule[min(previousOffenses, last)]
- /recovery-code: createRecoveryCodes(count = 10) → "XXXX-XXXX-XXXX" (alphabet 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ); normalizeRecoveryCode(code) → uppercase, no spaces or hyphens; hash with hashOneTimeCode(…, { purpose: "recovery:<account id>" })
- /email-contact: normalizeEmail(address) → trimmed lowercase (throws if not x@y); emailLedgerForm(address) → also without +tag
- Sign-in flow on AccountServer { database: Kysely<AccountServerDatabase> (account + protection tables; run migrateProtection and migrateAccount), channels: ContactChannel[], secret: ACCOUNT_SECRET (≥32), limits?: Partial<SignInLimits> } (DEFAULT_SIGN_IN_LIMITS at /account-server): /challenge-issue issueChallenge(server, { now? }) → Challenge; /sign-in-start startSignIn(server, { contact, solution, address, language, token?, now? }) → also { status: "signed-in", accountId } when the browser is already signed in to that contact's account (nothing sent) → { status: "sent", requestId, deliver() (call after responding) } | { status: "refused", reason: "proof" | "contact" | "unavailable" } | { status: "refused", reason: "rate-limit", retryAfterSeconds }; /sign-in-finish finishSignIn(server, { requestId, code, address, token?, now? }) → { status: "signed-in", accountId, token } | { status: "second-factor", ticket } (two-factor on: then /second-factor-finish finishSecondFactor(server, { ticket, code (TOTP or recovery code), address, token?, userAgent?, now? })) | { status: "sign-up", ticket } | { status: "refused", reason }; /sign-up-finish finishSignUp(server, { ticket, name, identifier, token?, userAgent?, now? }) → { status: "signed-in", accountId, token } | { status: "refused", reason: "ticket" | "name-invalid" | "identifier-invalid" | "identifier-taken" | "contact-taken" }; /secret-derivation deriveSecret(root, purpose) (HKDF-SHA-256, info "sharadox-account:<purpose>"); /signed-ticket createTicket(data, { secret, purpose, lifetimeSeconds, now? }), readTicket(ticket, { secret, purpose, now? }); /test-server createTestServerDatabase()
- Storage: migrateAccount(database) (own table account_migration): every id uuid v7, every foreign key ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE (audit_event.application_id RESTRICT). Tables: application (id, key, name; seeded key "account"), account (kind person|agent, name 1–50, owner_id for agents), identifier (value without "@", account_id; unique lower(value) across everything; every account has exactly one), contact (verified_at, sign_in; deferred trigger: a person keeps ≥1 verified sign-in contact), account_picture, totp_credential (secret_ciphertext, last_used_step, confirmed_at), recovery_code (code_hash, used_at), code_request, browser_session (user_agent), account_session (second_factor_at, step_up_at), audit_event (append-only). Types: AccountDatabase at /account-database/type. Tests: /test-database createTestAccountDatabase(), /test-person createTestPerson(database, identifier)
- /account-name: checkAccountName(name) → { valid: true, name (trimmed, single spaces) } | { valid: false, reason: "length" | "characters" }
- /account-name-change: changeAccountName(database, { accountId, name }) → { changed: true } | { changed: false, reason: "name-invalid" | "no-account" }
- /person-account: createPersonAccount(database, { name, identifier, contact: { kind, value }, now? }) → { created: true, accountId, contactId } | { created: false, reason: "name-invalid" | "identifier-invalid" | "identifier-taken" | "contact-taken" }; contact stored verified; audit account.created
- /identifier-availability: identifierAvailability(database, name) → "available" | "taken" | "invalid" (rate limit callers)
- /identifier-change: changeIdentifier(database, { accountId, identifier }) → { changed: true } | { changed: false, reason: "identifier-invalid" | "identifier-taken" | "no-account" }; audit detail { from, to }
- /contact-lookup: findAccountByContact(database, contact) → { accountId, contactId, signIn } | undefined (verified only)
- /contact-addition: addContact(database, { accountId, contact, now? }) → { added: true, contactId } | { added: false, reason: "already-added" | "contact-taken" | "no-account" } (unverified)
- /contact-verification: verifyContact(database, { accountId, contactId, now? }) → { verified: true } | { verified: false, reason: "no-contact" | "contact-taken" }
- /contact-removal: removeContact(database, { accountId, contactId }) → { removed: true } | { removed: false, reason: "no-contact" | "last-sign-in-contact" }
- /code-request: requestCode(database, { purpose: "sign-in" | "contact-verification" | "step-up", contact, accountId?, pepper, length = 6, lifetimeSeconds = 600, now? }) → { requestId, code, contact (normalized), expiresAt }; stores HMAC of `${purpose}:${requestId}`; voids open requests for same contact+purpose; table code_request
- /code-verification: verifyCode(database, { requestId, code, purpose, pepper, maximumAttempts = 5, now? }) → { valid: true, contact, accountId | null } | { valid: false, reason: "unknown" | "used" | "replaced" | "expired" | "attempts" | "wrong" }; row locked FOR UPDATE
- /code-request-prune: pruneCodeRequests(database, { before }) → number deleted (expires_at < before)
- Sessions (tables browser_session{token_hash SHA-256, expires_at}, account_session{browser_session_id, account_id, expires_at, last_seen_at, second_factor_at; unique per browser+account}): /account-sign-in signIn(database, { accountId, token?, secondFactor?, accountSessionSeconds = 30 d, browserSessionSeconds = 400 d, now? }) → { token (NEW every sign-in; set as __Host- cookie), browserSessionId, accountSessionId }; /browser-session-read readBrowserSession(database, { token?, idleSeconds = 7 d, now? }) → { browserSessionId, accounts: [{ accountSessionId, accountId, identifier, name, pictureId, signedInAt, secondFactorAt }] } | undefined; /account-sign-out signOut(database, { token?, accountId? }) → { signedOut: accountIds } (no accountId = all + browser session); /account-session-revocation revokeAccountSessions(database, { accountId, actorAccountId? }) → count; /session-prune pruneSessions(database, { idleSeconds?, now? }) → { accountSessions, browserSessions }; /session-token createSessionToken() → { token, hash }, hashSessionToken(token)
- /email-channel: createEmailChannel({ sender (email-web-library EmailSender), from, design (EmailDesign), logos?: InlineImage[] ("logo", "logo-dark"), now? }) → ContactChannel { kind: "email", send({ contact, code, purpose, language, expiresAt }) }; en or pt-PT (any "pt*"); code grouped in 3s ("123 456"), body only; type ContactChannel at /contact-channel/type
- /contact-kind: normalizeContact({ kind, value }) (email only; throws otherwise), CONTACT_KINDS
- /audit-event: recordAuditEvent(database, { action, accountId?, actorAccountId?, application?, detail?, now? }) → id
- /database-error: databaseError(error) → { code, constraint } | undefined
- /code-sending: sendCode(server, { purpose, contact, channel, accountId?, address, language, now? }) → { status: "sent", requestId, deliver } | refused "unavailable" | "rate-limit" (shared by every flow that sends a code)
- /step-up: startStepUp(server, { accountId, contactId, address, language }) (code to an own verified contact); finishStepUp(server, { accountId, requestId, code, token }) → { status: "confirmed" } | refused; hasFreshStepUp(database, { accountId, token }) → boolean (10 minutes, STEP_UP_SECONDS); require before contact, two-factor, recovery-code and deletion changes
- /contact-addition-flow: startContactAddition(server, { accountId, contact, address, language }) → { status: "sent", requestId, contactId, deliver } | refused "contact" | "already-added" | "contact-taken" | "no-account" | rate limits; finishContactAddition(server, { accountId, requestId, code }) → { status: "verified", contactId } | refused
- /totp-setup: startTotpSetup(server, { accountId, issuer }) → { status: "started", uri, secret (base 32) } | { status: "already-on" | "no-account" }; confirmTotpSetup(server, { accountId, code }) → { confirmed: true, recoveryCodes (10) } | { confirmed: false, reason: "wrong" | "none" }; removeTotp(database, { accountId }); totpStatus(database, { accountId }) → { on, recoveryCodesLeft }
- /recovery-code-regeneration: regenerateRecoveryCodes(server, { accountId }) → { status: "made", recoveryCodes } | { status: "second-factor-off" }
- /secret-encryption: encryptSecret(bytes, key ≥32) → "v1.<iv>.<ciphertext+tag>" (AES-256-GCM); decryptSecret(text, key)
- /picture-preparation: preparePicture(bytes) → { valid: true, bytes (WebP, ≤1024 px, metadata dropped, GIF animation kept, SVG rasterized), width, height } | { valid: false, reason: "size" (>5 MB) | "type" | "dimensions" (>4096) | "suspicious" | "unsafe" (SVG with external references or entities) }
- /account-picture-change: setAccountPicture(database, storage, { accountId, bytes }) → { changed: true, pictureId } | { changed: false, reason } (old file deleted after the new is stored); removeAccountPicture(database, storage, { accountId }) → { removed }; /picture-key pictureKey(id) → "account-picture/<id>.webp"; /picture-storage/type PictureStorage { put(key, bytes, contentType), remove(key) }; /memory-picture-storage createMemoryPictureStorage()
- /account-session-list: listAccountSessions(database, { accountId, token }) → [{ accountSessionId, userAgent, signedInAt, lastSeenAt, secondFactor, current }]; /account-session-end endAccountSession(database, { accountId, accountSessionId }) → { ended }
- /account-activity: listAccountActivity(database, { accountId, before?, limit = 50 }) → { events: [{ id, at, action, detail }], next }
- /account-export: exportAccount(database, { accountId }) → AccountExport (account, contacts, picture, secondFactor, sessions, activity; no secrets) | undefined
- /account-deletion: deleteAccount(database, storage, { accountId }) → { deleted } (picture file, account and all it owns; identifier freed; audit account.deleted)
- /account-server: accountTables(server) → the database typed as Kysely<AccountDatabase>
- /application-sync: syncApplication(database, { key, name, permissions: [{ key "<app>.x", description }], roles: [{ key, name, permissions, default?, exclusive? }] }) → { synced: true } | { synced: false, reason: "foreign-permission" | "unknown-permission" | "defaults", detail }
- /role-grant: grantRole(database, { accountId, application, role, resource?, startsAt?, endsAt?, source? "manual"|"membership"|"ban"|"system", grantedBy?, reason? }) → { granted, grantId } | { granted: false, reason: "no-role"|"no-account"|"not-allowed"|"escalation" } (grantedBy needs account.role.assign in "account" and every role permission); revokeGrant(database, { grantId, revokedBy? }) → { revoked }; listGrants(database, { accountId }) → GrantView[] { grantId, application, role, roleName, resource, startsAt, endsAt, source, reason, active }; ROLE_ASSIGN_PERMISSION
- /account-permission: accountPermissions(database, { accountId, application, resource?, scope?, now? }) → Set<string> (default role ∪ active grants; exclusive wins; ∩ scope; agents ∩ owner)
- Tables (0005-role): permission, role (application_id null = global, is_default, exclusive), role_permission, role_grant (role_id RESTRICT, granted_by SET NULL)
- /rule-sync: syncRules(database, { application | null, rules: [{ code, title, description, schedule }] }) → { versioned: codes, unknownApplication? }; listRules(database, { application }) → newest [{ code, version, title, description, schedule, global }]
- /account-ban: banAccount(database, { accountId, application, rules: codes, statement, evidence?, by? }) → { banned: true, banId, endsAt | null } | { banned: false, reason: "not-allowed" | "no-ban-role" | "no-rule", detail? } (length = banLength over this offense per rule); appealBan(database, { banId, accountId, text }) → one per ban; decideAppeal(database, { appealId, by, decision: "upheld"|"shortened"|"lifted", reasons, endsAt? }); listBans(database, { accountId }); BAN_PERMISSION "account.ban.create", APPEAL_PERMISSION "account.appeal.decide"
- /banned-contact: bannedContactHash(contact, pepper); contactBanned(database, { contact, pepper, application }); pruneBannedContacts(database); deleteAccount(database, storage, { accountId, ledgerPepper }) writes the ledger for active bans; finishSignUp / startContactAddition refuse "contact-banned"
- /account-inactivity: runInactivity(server, storage, { now? }) → { warned, deleted } (daily job; persons unused 2 years deleted; warnings 6m, 3m, 1m, 1w, 1d, once each, latest due only); deletionDate(lastActiveAt)
- /account-notice: notifyAccount(server, { accountId, notice, except? }) → every verified contact but except, in account.language (failures recorded as notice.delivery-failed); ContactChannel.notify({ contact, language, notice: inactivity-warning { deletionAt } | contact-added { contact } | recovery-code-used }); finishContactAddition and finishSecondFactor (recovery code) return notify() to call after answering; finishSignUp/createPersonAccount take language
